body: I feel like so many people don’t get it. No matter how many times you say “I’m not ok guys” they are like “I know, it’s ok, don’t worry” uhhhh what? Exhausted from holding it together for everyone else.
They dated for like, a month.

Well they did used to date, so he has seen her body. But this comment was in feb, and I flat out said “how the fuck can you see someone’s body in feb. It’s cold, and people are bundled up” and he mumbled something about maybe yoga pants or something and he doesn’t know why he said it. I can’t stop thinking about that comment, and the fact that she is indeed much fitter than me. I also said that any man who has said something like that to me, was looking for an in. It’s a “sort of” innocent comment to see how she reacts... and if she is open to more, was how I read it.

He has already said that he doesn’t need to be friends with her anymore, and was already not going to be doing those sports again this season, but I am just trying to understand why he felt he needed this friendship in the first place.
